quarterly_data.signal: Partner AMI (a Lattice Company): AMI MegaRAC OneTree BMC firmware (commercially supported OpenBMC) is available on Nuvoton's Arbel NPCM8XX BMC platform - a fourth-generation quad-core Arm Cortex-A35 BMC family - now for customer evaluation and development on the Arbel Evaluation Board, with support for production server platforms and customized deployments available through AMI and Nuvoton worldwide. The release states the NPCM8XX family carries OCP S.A.F.E. certification and FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic capabilities. Nuvoton VP Ken Su: the collaboration provides customers with a production-ready OpenBMC solution.
